title: Remembering Queen Elizabeth II
overview: Her late majesty Queen Elizabeth II had spent 70 Years on the throne which rules the British dominion. After the passing of king George IV, The young Princess would promise the world her duty would be carried out. From just 21 years of age, the burden of the crown rested upon the shoulders of our longest living monarch. One who inspired and provided hope to the masses. Her legacy will never be forgotten.
